description: Repository: joeharris76/joeharris76.com (not this one). Files: _blog/drafts/agent-instructions/testing-agent-instructions.md and _blog/outlines/agent-instructions/testing-agent-instructions.md. Problem: the second draft was fact-checked by an independent reviewer but has had no editorial critique; the first draft scored 6/10. The 14 corrections applied after the second fact check were never re-checked, and the draft is about 3,400 words against a 3,300 limit. Outcome: an independent critique of the current draft, its findings applied, the draft at or under 3,300 words, and a clean fact re-check. Decision gate: apply a finding only if it is a factual error, a broken link, a formatting fault or local wording. Findings that change the thesis, title, structure or a judgment go to the owner as a list and are not applied. If the critique scores the draft below 7/10, stop after reporting and do not apply anything. If local wording edits cannot bring the draft to 3,300 words, list proposed cuts for the owner and stop; do not cut a section or a result without the owner. This item runs after the loading-map rerun so that it is the last edit before the owner reads the draft. Guardrails: the critic and the fact checker are reviewer agents that did not write the draft and are given no author reasoning; they change no files. Fixed author decisions are not relitigated: first person singular, one post, models and public repositories named, Oxbow unnamed, costs per round, no account of how the work was organised. Every number added or changed is traced to a public report in evals/ablation/results or marked as from private notes. No em or en dashes (a grep for U+2014 and U+2013 in the draft returns 0). Merging _blog/ changes publishes nothing; do not touch content/ or public/ in this item.
